commits.message:
TextInput edits right-to-left text (rich-control-codes-xh4n.itm) (#556)

* TextInput shows, hits and moves through right-to-left text in its destination's order (rich-control-codes-xh4n.itm)

* TextInput reads each row as drawn: glyphs kept whole, rows at their line's direction, word steps across the screen (rich-control-codes-xh4n.itm)

* TextInput maps a press through the cells the frame drew, steps the window it showed, and counts any script's letters as a word (rich-control-codes-xh4n.itm)

* TextInput steps a word to the nearest edge on the key's side, derives its window, and does no ordering under plain (rich-control-codes-xh4n.itm)
words keeps segment edges, finds a run's clusters whole, sends kitty letters, and grants only kitty (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6pi)
words follows kitty's runs: unstamped text passes whole, faces and box cells end a run, and a run is written in the form kitty shows as laid (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6pi)
kitty gets the words order: rows laid out visually, each right-to-left word written in the order kitty turns back (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6pi)
